usedFor: Togile holds new leads, and HubSpot receives them as deals when “New Lead” runs “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Togile, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A lead received in Togile becomes a deal in HubSpot with its details passed along.

watchOut: “New Contact” and “New Lead” in Togile can both fire for one person, so “Create Deal” may run twice.
